description: This PHP class, EmailConfigurationListener, listens to Doctrine ORM lifecycle events related to EmailConfiguration entities. It handles encryption and decryption of SMTP passwords during entity persistence, update, and load events.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationListener
classes.description: Listener class for handling encryption/decryption of SMTP passwords on EmailConfiguration entities during Doctrine ORM lifecycle events.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before entity persistence if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before entity update if encryption is enabled and the field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after entity update if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after entity load if encryption is enabled.
